name: Logistics and transport
description: Freight, delivery, warehousing and supply-chain operators.

typical_workflows.name: Shipping document processing
typical_workflows.description: Read bills of lading, customs forms and delivery notes.

typical_workflows.name: Route and load planning
typical_workflows.description: Assign loads and routes to vehicles.

typical_workflows.name: Exception handling
typical_workflows.description: Handle delays, damage claims and missed deliveries.

typical_workflows.name: Carrier and rate quotes
typical_workflows.description: Collect and compare quotes from carriers.

compliance_notes: Delivery addresses and recipient names are personal data.
Customs and cargo documents may be legally binding; a person should confirm key fields.
Rates and customer contracts are commercially sensitive.
follow_up_questions: How many shipments or documents per month?
Are documents emailed PDFs, scans, EDI messages or system records?
Does your transport system already provide tracking and routing optimization?
Which regions or customs regimes do you operate in?
